title: Minimum Specification of LLM for MCP
body:
Hi everyone,

I just explore about the MCP and trying to use mongo-mcp server with the client like witsy. I was choosing my custom llm server which is of course compatible with OpenAI api, but unfortunately when I just give the prompt, it cannot properly call the mcp tool defined in the mcp server. Before, I was using the 7B qwen llm model, then, I change it to larger model and now the llm can properly call the mcp tool.

I just think, that maybe for tool calling, there must be a minimum specification of llm size for better reasoning. Maybe, any of you guys have an answer about this? Thanks
author: danielsyahputra

comments.body: Calling an MCP tool is more about having the proper format than the context size. I recommend using one of the FastMCP clients to expose a more standard function calling interface for custom implementations.

title: fix: use stderr for logging
body:
Without this, logs get sent to stdout which is captured by the
JSONRPC protocol (which also causes some errors with clients when
the invalid JSON is sent over the stdout pipe).
author: sd2k

comments.body: Thanks! This was sort of driving me crazy

title: Changes to accomodate windows users.
